scenes.alt: เจียงเซินกุมคางขณะที่ซ่งจื้อยังกันพี่สาวไว้

scenes.brief: Parking-lot aftermath, low wide angle. Song Yun stands straight with a chilled expression after the sudden clash, while Song Wan crouches beside stunned Jiang Shen, checking him anxiously. No contact, no visible injuries or blood. Filmic hard shadows and distance.
scenes.alt: ซ่งหว่านก้มดูอาการเจียงเซินหลังการปะทะ

scenes.brief: In the quiet rear passenger seats of the car, Song Yun turns from the dark window and rests a grateful hand on her younger brother's broad shoulder. Song Zhi straightens with tender surprise. Night lights blur outside, warmth returning to her tired expression.
scenes.alt: ซ่งอวิ๋นขอบใจซ่งจื้อในรถระหว่างกลับบ้าน

scenes.alt: ซ่งเต๋อวางมือบนศีรษะเจียงเซินขณะฟังคำขอโทษ

scenes.alt: เจียงซูกอดปลอบซ่งอวิ๋นเมื่อรู้เรื่องที่เธอถูกปองร้าย

scenes.brief: Daytime at the modern bakery-café. Song Wan in a cashier uniform serves Qin Chang, initially an arresting stranger. His black coffee and tuna bread sit on the table, dark gaze softening into a discreet smile as she works.

scenes.brief: After Nan Qiu rises and reluctantly apologizes to Song Yun with a stiff bow, Nan Rong sits steady behind silver glasses and answers the teacher about the cut handkerchief. Teacher and both sisters form a clean triangular composition at the same long desk.

scenes.alt: หนานจื่อเฉียงกังวลหลังความร่วมมือใหญ่ถูกปฏิเสธ

Straight rows in matched dark-green training clothes and low green caps, black canvas shoes, an instructor correcting alignment. Song Yun is lightly tanned and resolute in front; Nan Rong is visibly tired, Fan Yue still energetic. High summer daylight, no weapons.

scenes.brief: Near the campus exit moments later, Song Wan arrives with her rolling case and lights up at Qin Chang's gentle dinner invitation. Song Yun listens very intently, morning moisture glowing on foliage and stone path. Calm natural light, restrained over-the-shoulder composition.

characters.name: ซ่งอวิ๋น
characters.description: Song Yun. Chinese female protagonist entering her first university year. Slender, oval face with distinctive peach-blossom eyes and residual youthful softness, glossy black hair. Television performance look: long pearl-white gown with embroidered pearls on bodice, high black updo held by a pearl hairpin, small diamond earrings and subtle makeup (Ch 21–23). Mildly sun-tanned by Ch 30, with dark-green training uniform, matching cap and black canvas shoes for drills.

characters.name: ซ่งหว่าน
characters.description: Song Wan. Young Chinese woman, Song Yun's older half-sister and first-year student. Slim stature, phoenix-shaped eyes (Ch 28), shifts from carefully demure to hostile when alone. Neat bakery cashier uniform for workplace scenes. Keep her facial geometry distinct and consistent with the selected female reference.

characters.name: ซ่งจื้อ
characters.description: Song Zhi. Young Chinese man, Song Yun's younger brother. Handsome, notably broad shoulders and tall build. Bright youthful smile most of the time, switches to very focused, protective and serious under pressure. Model work and contemporary clothes.

characters.name: ซ่งเหวิน
characters.description: Song Wen. Chinese middle-aged man, father of Song Yun and Song Wan. Protective and gentle toward Song Wan; frequently stern, uneasy or defensive in family meetings. Modern wealthy-family styling.

characters.name: ซ่งเต๋อ
characters.description: Song De. Chinese elderly man, grandfather of Song Yun and Jiang Shen. Sharp observant eyes, silver eyebrows, a walking cane. Carries authority even when speaking gently; comfortably exercises at dawn. Contemporary refined clothes.

characters.name: โจวจิ่ว
characters.description: Zhou Jiu. Chinese middle-aged woman, Song Yun's mother. Attentive and protective posture, warm expressions toward young people, dignified modern clothes.

characters.name: ซ่งเซียง
characters.description: Song Xiang. Chinese middle-aged woman, wife of Jiang Guo and mother of Jiang Su and Jiang Shen. Looks notably younger than her age, striking finely shaped brows and observant eyes, self-possessed; stern and unsparing with her son after the fight.

characters.name: เจียงกั๋ว
characters.description: Jiang Guo. Chinese middle-aged man, chairman of bedding firm. Tall, lean and distinctly youthful-looking compared to his age, thick jet-black hair without gray. Fatherly appearance, defined by calm but uncompromising manner.

characters.name: เจียงเซิน
characters.description: Jiang Shen. Chinese young adult man, the second Jiang son, old enough to live independently. Confidence as a stage competitor, sharp changes into irritability and wounded pride with family. Preserve a youthful distinct face across confrontation and apology scenes.

characters.name: เจียงซู
characters.description: Jiang Su. Chinese young adult man, the elder Jiang son and eldest cousin Song Yun calls big brother. Adulthood, kind and protective expression, comfortably helps with bags and college transition. Different canonical face from his brother Jiang Shen.

characters.name: ฉินชาง
characters.description: Qin Chang. Chinese young adult man, second young master of the Qin family. About 180 cm, tall slim build, striking angular face with strong defined jaw, prominent straight nose, deep-set icy gaze and deeply shaped mouth. His small warm smile alters the mood without changing his identity; imposing stillness.

characters.name: หนานหรง
characters.description: Nan Rong. Young Chinese woman, eldest Nan daughter, first-year Tsinghua business student. Explicitly doll-sweet face, pale smooth skin, light pink lips, large round eyes, thin silver-frame glasses, long hair tied in a simple ponytail. Quiet and composed, smiles seldom, can be visibly sad; glasses and ponytail as visual continuity.

characters.name: หนานชิว
characters.description: Nan Qiu. Young Chinese woman and younger half-sister of Nan Rong, also a student. Proud, expressive and quick-tempered in these chapters. Silhouette and face should read differently from Nan Rong; do not give her Nan Rong's glasses.

characters.name: ฟ่านเยว่
characters.description: Fan Yue. Young Chinese woman, first-year engineering student living in Song Yun's dorm. Robust and athletic build, slightly round face, energetic posture, immediately sincere smile. Active even after training and unafraid to speak up.

characters.name: เฉียวอันฉี
characters.description: Qiao Anqi. Young Chinese woman, first-year business student and former close friend of Song Yun, all smiles and affectionate on campus, more cautious during conflict. Less physically hardy during military training. Use selected female reference to fix face.

characters.name: หนานจื่อเฉียง
characters.description: Nan Ziqiang. Fifty-year-old Chinese chairman. Stocky build, eyes distinctly angled upward and corners of his mouth turned down, unapproachable at rest. His voice and persuasive, controlled body language can seem soft in conversation.

characters.name: ผู้กำกับหู
characters.description: Director Hu. Middle-aged Chinese man, TV producer/director of a live singing competition, shares practical, amiable interest in production. Contemporary studio clothes, expressions range from warmly welcoming to gravely concerned.

characters.name: ช่างแต่งหน้า
characters.description: Unnamed Chinese woman in her late thirties, TV makeup artist. Affectionate and eager to see Song Yun again after having encountered her as a child singer. The same face appears healthy at the vanity and pale and weary in hospital following illness.

characters.name: บอดี้การ์ดสาว
characters.description: Unnamed Chinese adult woman, Song Yun's personal female bodyguard. Practical, alert demeanor, quick sure movements. Contemporary dark understated clothing suitable for a television backstage workplace.

characters.name: ทีมงานสาวสวมหมวกแก๊ป
characters.description: Unnamed adult Chinese woman presenting herself as studio crew. Plain, unmemorable face, staff cap and crew shirt. Actual identity unknown at this point; only a discreet delivery is shown.

characters.name: จ้าวอิ๋น
characters.description: Zhao Yin. Chinese Buddhist nun whom Song De consults at a shrine. Calm, observant, very composed eyes. Her spiritual robes and contemplative posture communicate vocation without implying an unsupported age or relationship.

characters.name: อาจารย์ฝ่ายกิจการนักศึกษา
characters.description: Unnamed middle-aged Chinese woman, head of Student Affairs. Strict-looking with thick-lensed glasses. Deliberate, fair manner, practical modern university office clothing.
